$Comment: Main-hand, two-handed. Model: the Pulse Rifle of Weapon_Gun, unchanged. No projectile, no muzzle flash, no recoil animation, no visible beam; while Primary is held the Arrakis_Cutter_Beam interaction throws molten globs off the surface it hits.
